user.title: Listen to a Viessmann E3 device
user.description: Passive: reads what the device broadcasts on the CAN bus and never sends anything. Query: asks for values with read requests only (UDS ReadDataByIdentifier); this integration contains no write command. The CAN interface must already be up (e.g. by the open3e app at 250 kbit/s).

data.min_interval: Minimum time between updates of a data point

data_description.can_id: Leave empty for the default. Passive: 0x451 (VX3, Vitoair, Vitodens), 0x693 (Vitocal). Query: ECU 0x680 (Vitocal), 0x6a2 (Vitoair). Not used for energy meters and the bus scan.
data_description.min_interval: Devices repeat their data many times per minute. A longer interval keeps the database smaller. 0 = every message.

error.cannot_connect: The CAN interface could not be opened. Check the name and that it is up.
error.invalid_can_id: Enter the CAN ID as a number, e.g. 0x451.
error.can_id_not_allowed: Energy meters and the bus scan use no CAN ID; leave this field empty.

abort.already_configured: This device is already being listened to on this interface.

options.scan: Bus scan (find out what is broadcast)
